name: 完整 8000 词（顺序版）
description: 常用 8000 词，按字母顺序排列，适合系统学习

words.example: She decided to abandon the plan at last.
words.exampleCn: 她最终决定放弃这个计划。

words.example: The abandonment of the project made the team feel very disappointed.
words.exampleCn: 这个项目被放弃让团队成员感到非常失望。

words.example: He felt deep abasement after being publicly shamed in front of all his colleagues.
words.exampleCn: 在所有同事面前被当众羞辱后，他深感屈辱。

words.example: The word "abbr." is a common abbreviation for "abbreviation".
words.exampleCn: “abbr.”是“abbreviation”的常见缩写形式。

words.example: The project has been held in abeyance until the funding is approved.
words.exampleCn: 该项目已被暂停，等待资金获批。

words.meaning: (by)遵守，坚持；(abode)持续，住，逗留vt. 容忍，忍受；等候
words.example: I can't abide people who are always late for appointments.
words.exampleCn: 我无法忍受约会总是迟到的人。

words.meaning: 能力；本领；才能，才干；专门技能，天资
words.example: She has the ability to solve difficult math problems quickly.
words.exampleCn: 她有能力快速解决复杂的数学题。

words.meaning: 有(能力、时间、知识等)做某事，有本事的
words.example: He is able to solve this difficult math problem.
words.exampleCn: 他能够解决这道难题。

words.example: His abnormal behavior made everyone around him feel worried.
words.exampleCn: 他反常的行为让身边的每个人都感到担忧。

words.meaning: /prep. 在船(飞机、车)上ad. 上船(飞机)
words.example: All the passengers went aboard the ship at the port.
words.exampleCn: 所有乘客都在港口登上了这艘船。

words.example: The government decided to abolish the old policy that restricted freedom of speech.
words.exampleCn: 政府决定废除这项限制言论自由的旧政策。

words.example: The abolition of slavery is one of the most important social progressions in human history.
words.exampleCn: 废除奴隶制是人类历史上最重要的社会进步之一。

words.example: The country passed a new law to regulate the abortion practice.
words.exampleCn: 该国通过了一项新法律来规范堕胎行为。

words.example: The attempt to climb the mountain was abortive due to the sudden heavy snowstorm.
words.exampleCn: 由于突如其来的暴雪，这次登山尝试以失败告终。

words.meaning: 在周围；大约prep. 关于；在周围a. 准备
words.example: I am about to go out to buy some groceries.
words.exampleCn: 我正要出门买些杂货。

words.meaning: 上述的ad. 在上面prep. 在…之上，高于
words.example: The bird is flying above the tree.
words.exampleCn: 鸟儿在树的上方飞翔。

words.example: Please refer to the above-mentioned points in your report.
words.exampleCn: 请在你的报告中参考上述要点。

words.example: We walked along the street abreast, chatting about our recent trip.
words.exampleCn: 我们并肩沿着街道散步，聊着我们最近的旅行。

words.example: The publisher decided to abridge the lengthy novel into a more accessible version for young readers.
words.exampleCn: 出版商决定将这部冗长的小说精简成更适合年轻读者的版本。

words.meaning: 到国外，在国外；在传播，在流传
words.example: He went abroad to study art last year.
words.exampleCn: 他去年出国学习艺术了。

words.example: The government decided to abrogate the outdated trade agreement.
words.exampleCn: 政府决定废除这项过时的贸易协定。

words.example: The government announced the abrogation of the outdated trade policy.
words.exampleCn: 政府宣布废除这项过时的贸易政策。

words.example: The sudden storm brought an abrupt end to our outdoor picnic.
words.exampleCn: 突如其来的暴风雨让我们的户外野餐草草收场。

words.example: The sudden storm made the picnic end abruptly.
words.exampleCn: 突如其来的暴风雨让野餐草草结束了。

words.meaning: 缺乏，不存在；缺席，不在；缺席的时间
words.example: His absence from the meeting made the boss very angry.
words.exampleCn: 他缺席这次会议让老板非常生气。

words.meaning: 缺席的；缺乏的，不存在的；心不在焉的
words.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he had a cold.
words.exampleCn: 他昨天因为感冒没来上学。

words.example: The absent-minded professor often forgets to bring his keys when he goes out.
words.exampleCn: 这位心不在焉的教授出门时经常忘记带钥匙。

words.meaning: 绝对的，完全的；确实的，肯定的
words.example: There is no absolute standard for beauty.
words.exampleCn: 美没有绝对的标准。

words.example: I absolutely agree with you on this matter.
words.exampleCn: 在这件事上我完全同意你的看法。

words.meaning: 吸收;吸引…的注意,使全神贯注
words.example: The sponge can absorb the spilled water quickly.
words.exampleCn: 这块海绵能迅速吸走洒出来的水。

words.example: The absorption of sunlight by the black cloth keeps us warm in winter.
words.exampleCn: 这块黑布对阳光的吸收让我们在冬天保持温暖。

words.meaning: 抽象的;n. (书籍、演说等的)摘要
words.example: The professor gave an abstract of his research report at the beginning of the lecture.
words.exampleCn: 教授在讲座开始时分享了他的研究报告摘要。

words.example: The poet talked about the beauty of abstraction in modern art.
words.exampleCn: 这位诗人谈论了现代艺术中抽象之美。

words.example: It is absurd to argue with a person who refuses to listen.
words.exampleCn: 和一个不肯听的人争论是荒谬可笑的。

words.example: The absurdity of his plan made everyone burst into laughter.
words.exampleCn: 他那个计划的荒谬之处让所有人都大笑起来。

words.example: The country has an abundance of natural resources like oil and coal.
words.exampleCn: 这个国家拥有丰富的石油、煤炭等自然资源。

words.meaning: 大量(充足)的；(in)丰富(富裕)的
words.example: There is abundant rainfall in this area in summer.
words.exampleCn: 这个地区夏季降雨量充沛。

words.example: He was arrested for drug abuse and physical abuse towards his family.
words.exampleCn: 他因吸食毒品以及对家人实施身体虐待而被逮捕。

words.example: The professor is engaged in academic research on environmental protection.
words.exampleCn: 这位教授正从事关于环境保护的学术研究。

words.meaning: (高等)专科院校；学术社团，协会，研究院
words.example: The private academy offers advanced courses in art and science.
words.exampleCn: 这所私立学院提供艺术和科学方面的高级课程。

words.example: The manager finally agreed to accede to our request for a paid vacation.
words.exampleCn: 经理最终同意了我们带薪休假的请求。

words.example: The driver stepped on the gas to accelerate the car and overtake the truck ahead.
words.exampleCn: 司机踩下油门加速，超过了前方的卡车。

words.example: The acceleration of the car from 0 to 100 km/h takes only 4.8 seconds.
words.exampleCn: 这辆汽车从0加速到100公里每小时仅需4.8秒。

words.meaning: 口音，腔调；重音(符号)vt. 重读
words.example: She speaks English with a strong British accent.
words.exampleCn: 她说英语带着浓重的英国口音。

words.meaning: 接受，领受；认可，同意vi. 同意，认可
words.example: I gladly accept your kind invitation.
words.exampleCn: 我欣然接受你诚挚的邀请。

words.example: The proposal is acceptable to most of the team members.
words.exampleCn: 这个提议被团队里的大多数成员所接受。

words.meaning: 接受，接收，验收，接纳；承认，认可
words.example: His acceptance of the offer made us all very happy.
words.exampleCn: 他接受了这个提议，这让我们所有人都非常开心。

words.meaning: 存取(计算机文件); n. 通道;入口;接近,进入;(to)接近(或进入、享用)的机会
words.example: You need a password to access the system.
words.exampleCn: 你需要密码才能进入这个系统。

words.example: The new subway system makes the remote town accessible to more tourists.
words.exampleCn: 新的地铁系统让这个偏远小镇能被更多游客抵达。

words.example: She bought a beautiful silk scarf as an accessory for her little black dress.
words.exampleCn: 她买了一条漂亮的丝巾作为她那件小黑裙的配饰。

words.meaning: 意外遭遇，事故；意外(因素)
words.example: I had a small traffic accident on my way to work this morning.
words.exampleCn: 今天早上我在上班的路上遭遇了一场小交通事故。

words.meaning: 偶然的；意外的；无意中的
words.example: I met my old friend on the street by accidental chance.
words.exampleCn: 我在街上偶然碰到了我的老朋友。

words.example: I accidentally broke the glass on the table just now.
words.exampleCn: 我刚才不小心打碎了桌上的玻璃杯。

words.example: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
words.exampleCn: 这家酒店最多可容纳500位客人。

words.example: We booked accommodation at a seaside hotel for our holiday.
words.exampleCn: 我们为假期预订了一家海边酒店的住宿。

words.example: The piano played a beautiful accompaniment for the singer's performance.
words.exampleCn: 钢琴为这位歌手的表演伴奏了一段美妙的旋律。

words.example: I will accompany my grandma to the hospital tomorrow.
words.exampleCn: 我明天会陪我奶奶去医院。

words.example: With perseverance, we can accomplish even the most difficult tasks.
words.exampleCn: 凭借毅力，我们甚至可以完成最艰巨的任务。

words.example: Finishing the 100-kilometer ultra marathon in under 12 hours is a remarkable accomplishment.
words.exampleCn: 在12小时内完成100公里超级马拉松是一项了不起的成就。

words.meaning: 相一致;相符合; vt. 授予,赠与; n. 一致,符合;(尤指国与国之间的)谅解
words.example: The two sides finally reached an accord to end the long-lasting conflict.
words.exampleCn: 双方最终达成了协议，结束了这场持续已久的冲突。

words.example: The project was carried out in accordance with the original plan.
words.exampleCn: 这个项目是按照原定计划进行的。

words.example: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
words.exampleCn: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。

words.meaning: 相应地，照着办，按照；于是，因此
words.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so we will adjust our picnic plan accordingly.
words.exampleCn: 天气预报说明天会下雨，因此我们会相应地调整野餐计划。

words.meaning: 账目;账户;计算;vt./vi. 说明
words.example: I need to check my bank account to see if the salary has arrived.
words.exampleCn: 我需要查看我的银行账户看看工资是否到账了。

words.example: My sister is a certified accountant who helps small businesses manage their taxes.
words.exampleCn: 我的姐姐是一名注册会计师，帮助小企业处理税务事宜。

words.example: She is studying accounting at university and wants to become a certified public accountant later.
words.exampleCn: 她正在大学学习会计学，之后想成为一名注册会计师。

words.example: Interest will accrue on the savings account if you don’t withdraw the money.
words.exampleCn: 如果你不取这笔钱，储蓄账户就会产生利息。

words.example: The interest accrued on my savings account over the past year is quite substantial.
words.exampleCn: 过去一年里，我储蓄账户上产生的利息相当可观。

words.example: Over time, we accumulate a lot of old photos and letters.
words.exampleCn: 随着时间推移，我们积攒了大量旧照片和信件。

words.example: The accumulation of plastic waste in the ocean has become a serious environmental problem.
words.exampleCn: 海洋中塑料垃圾的堆积已经成为一个严重的环境问题。

words.example: The accumulative effect of years of smoking has badly damaged his lungs.
words.exampleCn: 多年吸烟的累积效应已经严重损害了他的肺部。

words.example: The new system has been praised for its accuracy and speed.
words.exampleCn: 这套新系统因其精准性和速度而受到赞誉。

words.meaning: 正确无误的；准确的，精确的
words.example: The scientist's accurate measurement of the chemical reaction won high praise from his peers.
words.exampleCn: 这位科学家对化学反应的精准测量赢得了同行的高度赞誉。

words.example: The survey was designed to accurately measure the residents' satisfaction with the public transport system.
words.exampleCn: 这项调查旨在准确衡量居民对公共交通系统的满意度。

words.example: He denied the accusation of stealing the company's confidential documents.
words.exampleCn: 他否认了窃取公司机密文件的指控。

words.example: The police accused him of stealing the old man's wallet.
words.exampleCn: 警方指控他偷了这位老人的钱包。

words.example: You need to accustom yourself to the local diet when you go abroad.
words.exampleCn: 当你出国时，你需要让自己适应当地的饮食。

words.meaning: 痛；哀怜n. (指连续)疼痛、酸痛
words.example: I have a slight ache in my back after working all day.
words.exampleCn: 工作了一整天后，我后背有点轻微的疼痛。

words.example: My shoulders are aching after carrying all those heavy boxes.
words.exampleCn: 搬完那些重箱子后，我的肩膀很酸痛。

words.example: With consistent hard work, he finally achieved his dream of becoming a pilot.
words.exampleCn: 通过持之以恒的努力，他最终实现了成为一名飞行员的梦想。

words.example: Winning the championship was the most precious achievement of his athletic career.
words.exampleCn: 赢得这次冠军是他职业生涯中最珍贵的成就。

words.meaning: 酸的,尖刻的 n. 酸
words.example: Lemon juice contains citric acid which gives it a sour taste.
words.exampleCn: 柠檬汁含有柠檬酸，这赋予了它酸味。

words.meaning: 承认;表示收到信件;表示感谢
words.example: I must acknowledge the help you offered when I was in trouble.
words.exampleCn: 我必须感谢你在我陷入困境时给予的帮助。

words.example: He sent an email to the company as an acknowledgment of their help.
words.exampleCn: 他给公司发了一封邮件，以感谢他们的帮助。

words.example: I want to acquaint myself with the local customs before travelling there.
words.exampleCn: 我想要在去那里旅行前了解当地的风俗习惯。

words.meaning: 认识，相识，了解；相识的人，熟人
words.example: I only know him as a nodding acquaintance, not a close friend.
words.exampleCn: 我只是和他泛泛之交，算不上亲密朋友。

words.example: I am acquainted with the basic rules of this game.
words.exampleCn: 我熟悉这个游戏的基本规则。

words.example: I want to acquire some practical skills during the summer vacation.
words.exampleCn: 我想要在暑假期间学到一些实用技能。

words.meaning: 取得，学到，养成(习惯)；获得的东西
words.example: The company announced a major acquisition of a rival tech firm last week.
words.exampleCn: 这家公司上周宣布了收购一家竞争对手科技公司的重大交易。

words.example: The farm covers about 500 acres of land.
words.exampleCn: 这个农场占地约500英亩。

words.example: The young acrobat performed a breathtaking tightrope walk at the circus.
words.exampleCn: 这位年轻的杂技演员在马戏团表演了一场令人屏息的走钢丝节目。

words.example: The children were amazed by the acrobatics performed by the circus artists.
words.exampleCn: 孩子们对马戏团演员表演的杂技技艺感到惊叹。

words.meaning: 横过，越过；在的对面ad. 横过，穿过
words.example: The river flows across the city from west to east.
words.exampleCn: 这条河从西向东流经这座城市。

words.meaning: 表演；举动；起作用n. 行为，法令；一幕
words.example: I will act as a volunteer at the community center this weekend.
words.exampleCn: 这个周末我将在社区中心当一名志愿者。

words.meaning: 行动，动作；作用；运转；行为；战斗
words.example: Taking immediate action is the best way to solve this urgent problem.
words.exampleCn: 采取立即行动是解决这个紧急问题的最佳方式。

words.example: You need to activate the new phone before using it.
words.exampleCn: 你需要先激活这部新手机才能使用它。

words.meaning: 活跃的，敏捷的，积极的；在活动中的
words.example: She is an active member of the local hiking club.
words.exampleCn: 她是当地徒步旅行俱乐部的活跃成员。

words.example: He actively participates in various volunteer activities every weekend.
words.exampleCn: 他每个周末都积极参加各类志愿活动。

words.example: Doing outdoor activities is good for our health.
words.exampleCn: 进行户外活动对我们的健康有益。

words.example: The famous actor starred in a new science fiction movie last year.
words.exampleCn: 这位知名男演员去年主演了一部新的科幻电影。

words.example: The famous actress won the best actress award at the film festival.
words.exampleCn: 这位知名女演员在电影节上斩获了最佳女演员奖。

words.meaning: 实际的；现实的，真实的，目前的
words.example: The actual cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
words.exampleCn: 这次旅行的实际花费比我们预期的要高。

words.example: The movie tries to reflect the actuality of rural life in America.
words.exampleCn: 这部电影试图反映美国乡村生活的真实状况。

words.example: I actually didn't finish my homework yesterday.
words.exampleCn: 我昨天其实没完成我的作业。

words.meaning: 厉害的;敏锐的;(疾病等)急性的
words.example: The patient is suffering from acute appendicitis and needs immediate surgery.
words.exampleCn: 这名患者患有急性阑尾炎，需要立即进行手术。

words.example: The castle was built in 12th century a.d.
words.exampleCn: 这座城堡建于公元12世纪。

words.example: I saw an ad for a new coffee shop on the street.
words.exampleCn: 我在街上看到了一家新咖啡店的广告。

words.example: We must adapt to the new working environment as soon as possible.
words.exampleCn: 我们必须尽快适应新的工作环境。

words.example: The species has developed a special adaptation to survive in the extreme cold environment.
words.exampleCn: 这个物种进化出了特殊的适应能力以在极端寒冷的环境中生存。

words.meaning: 加；增加(进)；进一步说/写vi. (to)增添
words.example: Please add some sugar to the milk.
words.exampleCn: 请往牛奶里加些糖。

words.meaning: 加，加法；附加部分，增加(物)
words.example: Addition of the local flavor to the dish makes it more delicious.
words.exampleCn: 给这道菜加入本地特色风味后，它变得更加美味了。

words.example: We need additional time to finish the project on time.
words.exampleCn: 我们需要额外的时间才能按时完成这个项目。

words.example: Milk often has additives to extend its shelf life.
words.exampleCn: 牛奶通常会添加添加剂以延长保质期。

words.meaning: 住址,致词 vt. 向…致词,在信封上写姓名、住址
words.example: Please write down your full name and address on the form.
words.exampleCn: 请在表格上写下你的全名和地址。

words.example: The supply of food here is barely adequate for the local residents during the winter.
words.exampleCn: 这里的食物供应勉强够当地居民过冬。

words.example: The new system can adequately handle the daily workload of the company.
words.exampleCn: 这套新系统能够胜任公司的日常工作量。

words.example: The sticker will adhere firmly to the smooth surface.
words.exampleCn: 这种贴纸能牢牢粘在光滑的表面上。

words.example: This strong adhesive can stick the broken ceramic mug back together well.
words.exampleCn: 这种强力粘合剂能把破碎的陶瓷杯很好地粘回去。

words.example: The café is adjacent to the bookstore.
words.exampleCn: 那家咖啡馆紧邻书店。

words.meaning: 形容词a. 形容词的，用作形容词的
words.example: The word "beautiful" is a common adjective in English.
words.exampleCn: “beautiful”这个单词是英语中常见的形容词。

words.example: The new office building adjoins the city library.
words.exampleCn: 新的办公楼紧邻市图书馆。

words.example: Please adjust the air conditioner to make the room cooler.
words.exampleCn: 请把空调调一下，让房间更凉快些。

words.example: The height of this office chair is adjustable.
words.exampleCn: 这款办公椅的高度是可调节的。

words.example: I need to make some adjustments to my study plan before the final exam.
words.exampleCn: 期末考试前我需要对我的学习计划做一些调整。

words.meaning: 掌管,料理…的事务;实施;给予,派给,投(药)
words.example: The government will administer the new policy next month.
words.exampleCn: 政府将于下月实施这项新政策。

words.meaning: 经营，管理；行政，行政机关，管理部门
words.example: The company’s administration is handling the new project carefully.
words.exampleCn: 这家公司的管理部门正在认真推进这个新项目。

words.example: The company's administrative department is responsible for handling daily office affairs.
words.exampleCn: 这家公司的行政部门负责处理日常办公事务。

words.example: The teacher's devotion to education is really admirable.
words.exampleCn: 这位老师对教育事业的奉献精神着实令人钦佩。

words.example: She looked at the young pianist with great admiration for his talent.

words.exampleCn: 这个小女孩和她的祖母同名，祖母也叫艾米丽。

words.example: I usually take a 20-minute nap after lunch.
words.exampleCn: 我通常在午饭后小睡20分钟。

words.example: She laid a cloth napkin on the dinner plate before serving the meal.
words.exampleCn: 上菜前，她把一块布餐巾摆在餐盘上。

words.example: The author will narrate the thrilling adventure story in his new book.
words.exampleCn: 这位作者将在他的新书中讲述这个惊心动魄的冒险故事。

words.example: The novel's vivid narration makes readers feel like they are on the scene.
words.exampleCn: 这本小说生动的叙述让读者仿佛身临其境。

words.example: The narrator in the film shared the protagonist's inner thoughts with the audience.
words.exampleCn: 这部影片中的旁白/解说员向观众分享了主角的内心想法。

words.example: The narrow path leads to the old cottage at the foot of the mountain.
words.exampleCn: 这条狭窄的小路通向山脚下的老 cottage（小屋）。

words.meaning: 令人讨厌的;困难的;严重的,恶劣的;下流的
words.example: The stranger made a nasty comment about her appearance.
words.exampleCn: 那个陌生人对她的外表说了一句刻薄的话。

words.example: The whole nation was in deep sorrow after the great disaster.
words.exampleCn: 这场重大灾难过后，整个国家都沉浸在深切的悲痛之中。

words.example: The national park is famous for its beautiful lakes and forests.
words.exampleCn: 这个国家公园以其美丽的湖泊和森林而闻名。

words.example: Her nationality is Chinese, but she lives in France now.
words.exampleCn: 她的国籍是中国，但现在住在法国。

words.meaning: 本地的，本国的；天生的n. 本地人，本国人
words.example: She is a native of Beijing, so she knows the city very well.
words.exampleCn: 她是土生土长的北京人，所以对这座城市非常了解。

words.meaning: 正常的；自然界的，天然的，天赋的，固有的
words.example: It's natural to feel nervous before a big exam.
words.exampleCn: 在重要考试前感到紧张是很正常的。

words.example: She naturally stood out in the crowd for her beautiful dress.
words.exampleCn: 她因为漂亮的裙子在人群中格外显眼。

words.meaning: 自然界，大自然；性质，本性，天性
words.example: People often go to the countryside to get close to nature and relax themselves.
words.exampleCn: 人们常常去乡间亲近自然，放松身心。

words.example: The naughty boy hid his teacher's chalk secretly.
words.exampleCn: 那个调皮的男孩偷偷藏起了老师的粉笔。

words.example: Pregnant women often suffer from nausea in the early stage of pregnancy.
words.exampleCn: 孕妇在怀孕初期常常会感到恶心。

words.example: The naval fleet is carrying out a routine training mission in the Pacific Ocean.
words.exampleCn: 这支海军舰队正在太平洋执行例行训练任务。

words.example: The midwife cleaned the newborn's navel carefully after delivery.
words.exampleCn: 助产士在分娩后仔细清洁了新生儿的肚脐。

words.meaning: (江河、海洋)可航行的,可通航的;(船)适航的
words.example: The river is navigable for large cargo ships.
words.exampleCn: 这条河可供大型货船通航。

words.example: The ship's captain is in charge of navigation during the long voyage.
words.exampleCn: 这位船长负责这次长途航行中的导航工作。

words.example: He joined the navy after graduating from high school.
words.exampleCn: 他高中毕业后参军海军。

words.meaning: 近的，接近的；亲近的prep. 靠近ad. 接近
words.example: My school is near the park.
words.exampleCn: 我的学校在公园附近。

words.meaning: 附近的ad. 在附近prep. 在…附近
words.example: The café nearby serves the best homemade bread in town.
words.exampleCn: 附近这家咖啡馆供应着全镇最好的自制面包。

words.example: I have nearly finished my homework.
words.exampleCn: 我差不多完成我的作业了。

words.meaning: 整洁的;雅致的;灵巧的;纯的;不掺水的
words.example: Her room is always neat and tidy.
words.exampleCn: 她的房间总是整洁又有条理。

words.example: Success does not necessarily mean happiness.
words.exampleCn: 成功并不一定意味着幸福。

words.meaning: 必需的，必要的；必然的n. 必需品
words.example: It is necessary for us to wear masks in public places during the pandemic.
words.exampleCn: 疫情期间，我们在公共场所佩戴口罩是必要的。

words.example: The sudden storm will necessitate a change of our travel plan.
words.exampleCn: 突如其来的暴风雨将迫使我们改变旅行计划。

words.meaning: 必要性，需要；必然性；(pl.)必需品
words.example: Water is a basic necessity for human survival.
words.exampleCn: 水是人类生存的基本必需品。

words.example: She wore a beautiful scarf around her neck.
words.exampleCn: 她脖子上围着一条漂亮的围巾。

words.example: She wore a delicate silver necklace to the party.
words.exampleCn: 她戴着一条精致的银项链去参加派对了。

words.meaning: v./v. 需要；必须n. 需要；贫困，困窘
words.example: I need a cup of hot coffee after a long day's work.
words.exampleCn: 忙碌了一整天后，我需要一杯热咖啡。

words.example: The needful preparations for the party have been finished ahead of schedule.
words.exampleCn: 这场派对必要的准备工作已经提前完成了。

words.example: She used a needle and thread to sew the button back onto her coat.
words.exampleCn: 她用针和线把外套上的扣子缝了回去。

words.example: It's needless to argue with him about such a small matter.
words.exampleCn: 为这么点小事和他争论是没有必要的。

words.example: The local charity is trying to help the needy families in the town.
words.exampleCn: 当地的慈善机构正努力帮助镇上贫困的家庭。

words.example: The new policy will negate the efforts we made last year.
words.exampleCn: 这项新政策将会抵消我们去年付出的所有努力。

words.example: The double negation in logic means two negative words cancel each other out.
words.exampleCn: 逻辑学中的双重否定意味着两个否定词会相互抵消。

words.meaning: 否定的，消极的，阴性的n. 负数；(摄影)底片
words.example: The doctor said the test result was negative, so I don't have that disease.
words.exampleCn: 医生说检测结果是阴性的，所以我没有那种疾病。

words.meaning: 忽视,忽略;疏忽,玩忽;n. (U)疏忽,玩忽
words.example: Don't neglect your health even when you are busy with work.
words.exampleCn: 即使你工作繁忙，也不要忽视自己的健康。

words.example: His negligence of the safety regulations led to the serious factory accident.
words.exampleCn: 他对安全规程的疏忽导致了这场严重的工厂事故。

words.example: The restaurant was fined because the manager was negligent in checking the food safety conditions.
words.exampleCn: 这家餐厅因经理在检查食品安全状况时疏忽大意而被罚款。

words.meaning: 可忽略不计的，微不足道的
words.example: The amount of money I lost in the transaction is negligible.
words.exampleCn: 我在这笔交易里损失的金额微不足道。

words.meaning: 可谈判的,可商议的;可兑换现金的;可通行的(道路、河流)
words.example: The terms of the contract are negotiable before we sign it.
words.exampleCn: 我们在签署这份合同前，其条款是可以协商的。

words.example: We need to negotiate a better price for the raw materials.
words.exampleCn: 我们需要就原材料的更优价格进行谈判。

words.example: After long hours of negotiation, the two sides finally reached a peaceful agreement.
words.exampleCn: 经过数小时的谈判，双方最终达成了和平协议。

words.example: The term 'negro' is now considered outdated and offensive in most contemporary English contexts.
words.exampleCn: “negro”这个术语在当代大多数英语语境中被认为是过时且冒犯性的。

words.example: My next-door neighbor often helps me carry heavy things.
words.exampleCn: 我的邻居经常帮我搬重物。

words.example: I often walk my dog in the neighborhood after dinner.
words.exampleCn: 我经常晚饭后在社区里遛狗。

words.example: The neighboring café serves the most delicious homemade cookies.
words.exampleCn: 隔壁那家咖啡馆卖的自制曲奇饼干最好吃了。

words.meaning: 两者都不pron. 两者都不ad. 也不
words.example: I don't like either of the two books, and I don't like neither of them actually.
words.exampleCn: 这两本书我都不喜欢，而且事实上我哪一本都不喜欢。

words.example: My nephew is a lovely 10-year-old boy who loves playing basketball.
words.exampleCn: 我的侄子是个可爱的10岁男孩，他喜欢打篮球。

words.example: She felt a sudden surge of nerve before stepping onto the stage.
words.exampleCn: 站在舞台前，她突然鼓起了勇气。

words.meaning: 神经的；神经过敏的，紧张不安的
words.example: I felt nervous before my first job interview.
words.exampleCn: 我在第一次求职面试前感到紧张不安。

words.example: The bird built a warm nest in the tall tree.
words.exampleCn: 那只鸟在高高的树上筑了一个温暖的巢。

words.example: She nestled her head on his shoulder.
words.exampleCn: 她把头靠在他的肩膀上。

words.meaning: 网，网状物v. 用网捕，使落网a. 纯净的
words.example: She caught a small fish with a fishing net.
words.exampleCn: 她用渔网捉到了一条小鱼。

words.meaning: 网状物；广播网，电视网；网络
words.example: The company has built a strong sales network across the country.
words.exampleCn: 这家公司在全国建立了强大的销售网络。

words.example: The country has always remained neutral in international conflicts.
words.exampleCn: 这个国家在国际冲突中始终保持中立。

words.example: The country declared its neutrality in the ongoing international conflict.
words.exampleCn: 该国在持续的国际冲突中宣布了中立。

words.example: A neutron is a subatomic particle with no net electric charge.
words.exampleCn: 中子是一种不带净电荷的亚原子粒子。

words.meaning: 永不，从不，决不；从来没有；不，没有
words.example: I will never forget the days we spent together.
words.exampleCn: 我永远不会忘记我们一起度过的时光。

words.example: He is very tired; nevertheless, he keeps on working.
words.exampleCn: 他非常疲惫，但还是继续工作。

words.meaning: 新(近)的；新来的；不熟悉的；没经验的
words.example: I bought a new laptop last week.
words.exampleCn: 我上周买了一台新笔记本电脑。

words.meaning: 新闻，消息；新闻报道，新闻广播
words.example: I often watch the evening news to know what's happening around the world.
words.exampleCn: 我经常看晚间新闻来了解世界各地正在发生的事情。

words.example: I read the newspaper every morning over breakfast.
words.exampleCn: 我每天早上边吃早餐边看报纸。

words.meaning: 紧接的，其次的；贴近的ad. 其次；居后
words.example: I'll meet you at the next bus stop.
words.exampleCn: 我会在下一个公交站和你碰面。

words.meaning: 美好的，令人愉快的；友好的，亲切的
words.example: The cake you made yesterday was really nice.
words.exampleCn: 你昨天做的蛋糕真的很好吃。

words.example: The kid put a nickel into the vending machine to buy a bottle of juice.
words.exampleCn: 这个孩子把一枚五分镍币放进自动售货机里买了一瓶果汁。

words.meaning: 绰号，浑名vt. 给…起绰号
words.example: My friends gave me the nickname Lucky because I always win small prizes occasionally.
words.exampleCn: 我的朋友们给我取了昵称“幸运儿”，因为我偶尔总能赢些小奖品。

words.example: My brother's daughter is my niece.
words.exampleCn: 我兄弟的女儿是我的侄女（甥女）。

words.example: I usually go to bed at 11 o'clock at night.
words.exampleCn: 我通常在晚上11点上床睡觉。

words.example: She put on a soft cotton nightgown before going to bed.
words.exampleCn: 她上床睡觉前穿上了一件柔软的棉质睡裙。

words.example: The nightingale sang beautifully in the moonlit garden.
words.exampleCn: 夜莺在洒满月光的花园里动听地歌唱。

words.meaning: 恶梦；可怕的事物，无法摆脱的恐惧
words.example: I had a terrible nightmare about being chased by a huge monster last night.
words.exampleCn: 昨晚我做了一个被巨型怪物追赶的可怕噩梦。

words.example: I have nine apples on the table.
words.exampleCn: 我的桌子上有九个苹果。

words.meaning: num./a. 十九pron. 十九(个，只…)
words.example: There are nineteen students in our classroom.
words.exampleCn: 我们教室里有十九名学生。

words.example: There are ninety students in the school auditorium.
words.exampleCn: 学校礼堂里有九十名学生。

words.example: Today is my little sister's ninth birthday.
words.exampleCn: 今天是我妹妹的九岁生日。

words.example: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the Earth's atmosphere.
words.exampleCn: 氮气约占地球大气层的78%。

words.meaning: 不是，不a. 没有的；不允许n. 不，拒绝
words.example: I'm sorry, there's no more coffee left in the pot.
words.exampleCn: 抱歉，壶里已经没有咖啡了。

words.example: I have no idea about this problem.
words.exampleCn: 我对这个问题一无所知。

words.example: The nobility has long played an important role in European history.
words.exampleCn: 贵族阶层在欧洲历史上长期发挥着重要作用。

words.meaning: 高尚的；贵族的，高贵的n. 贵族
words.example: The noble knight devoted his life to protecting the innocent villagers.
words.exampleCn: 这位高贵的骑士毕生致力于保护无辜的村民。

words.meaning: 谁也不，无人n. 小人物
words.example: Nobody knows what will happen tomorrow.
words.exampleCn: 没有人知道明天会发生什么。

words.meaning: 点(头)，点头招呼n. 点头招呼；打盹，瞌睡
words.example: She nodded to show that she agreed with the plan.
words.exampleCn: 她点头表示她同意这个计划。

words.example: Don't make so much noise, the baby is sleeping.
words.exampleCn: 别这么吵闹，宝宝在睡觉。

words.example: The noisy children were playing in the yard happily.
words.exampleCn: 那些吵闹的孩子们正在院子里开心地玩耍。

words.meaning: 名义上的,有名无实的;极微的;象征性的
words.example: The new manager only got a nominal pay rise this year.
words.exampleCn: 这位新经理今年只获得了象征性的加薪。

words.example: The committee will nominate a new candidate for the position.
words.exampleCn: 委员会将为该职位提名一位新候选人。

words.example: After months of hard work, she finally got the nomination for the Best Actress award.
words.exampleCn: 经过数月的努力工作，她最终获得了最佳女演员奖的提名。

words.meaning: 没有任何人(东西)；都不ad. 一点也不
words.example: None of us knows how to solve this tough problem.
words.exampleCn: 我们当中没人知道如何解决这个棘手的问题。

words.example: Don't listen to his nonsense; he just made up the whole story.
words.exampleCn: 别听他的胡言乱语，他整个故事都是编出来的。

words.example: We have lunch at noon every day.
words.exampleCn: 我们每天中午吃午饭。

words.example: I don't like coffee, nor do I like tea.
words.exampleCn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。

words.example: It is a social norm to wait in line when buying tickets.
words.exampleCn: 购票时排队是一种社会行为准则。

words.meaning: 正常的，普通的；正规的，标准的
words.example: Everything is back to normal after the holiday.
words.exampleCn: 假期结束后，一切都恢复正常了。

words.example: The normalization of diplomatic relations between the two countries has promoted bilateral economic and trade cooperation.
words.exampleCn: 两国间的外交关系正常化推动了双边经贸合作。

words.example: We need to normalize the data before conducting the statistical analysis.
words.exampleCn: 我们在进行统计分析之前需要对数据进行标准化处理。

words.example: I normally go to work by subway.
words.exampleCn: 我通常乘地铁去上班。

words.meaning: 北，北方a. 北方的，北部ad. 向北方，在北方
words.example: The wind is blowing from the north today.
words.exampleCn: 今天风从北边吹来。

words.meaning: 东北a. 东北方的ad. 向东北，在东北
words.example: The small town is located in the northeast of the country.
words.exampleCn: 这个小镇位于该国的东北部。

words.example: The northern region of this country is very cold in winter.
words.exampleCn: 这个国家的北部地区冬天非常寒冷。

words.example: We are driving northward to visit our grandparents in the countryside.
words.exampleCn: 我们正驾车向北前往乡下看望我们的祖父母。

words.meaning: 西北方，西北部a. 西北的ad. 向西北，在西北
words.example: The small village lies in the northwest of the country.
words.exampleCn: 这个小村庄位于该国的西北部。

words.meaning: 鼻子；(飞机，船等的)前端，突出部分
words.example: She has a small cute nose and a pair of big bright eyes.
words.exampleCn: 她有一个小巧可爱的鼻子和一双明亮的大眼睛。

words.example: The cold wind made my nostrils sting a little.
words.exampleCn: 寒风让我的鼻孔有点刺痛。

words.example: I do not like coffee.
words.exampleCn: 我不喜欢咖啡。

words.meaning: 值得注意的,著名的;可觉察的;n. 名人,要人
words.example: The scientist made a notable breakthrough in the field of genetic engineering.
words.exampleCn: 这位科学家在基因工程领域取得了一项显著的突破。

words.meaning: 尤其，值得注意地,明显地
words.example: Many old buildings have been preserved in the city, notably the 18th-century church.
words.exampleCn: 这座城市保留了许多古建筑，尤其是那座18世纪的教堂。

words.meaning: 笔记；按语，注释；钞票，纸币v. 记下，摘下
words.example: Please take down some important notes during the lecture.
words.exampleCn: 请在讲座期间记下一些重要的笔记。

words.example: I always carry a notebook with me to jot down random ideas.
words.exampleCn: 我总是随身带着一本笔记本，用来记下随机冒出来的想法。

words.example: I noted down his address and phone number just now.
words.exampleCn: 我刚刚记下了他的地址和电话号码。

words.example: Taking effective note-taking can help you grasp key points quickly during lectures.
words.exampleCn: 高效的记笔记技巧能帮你在课堂上快速掌握重点。

words.meaning: 没有东西；什么也没有；无关紧要的人或事
words.example: There is nothing in the empty box.
words.exampleCn: 这个空盒子里什么都没有。

words.meaning: 通知，通告，布告；注意，认识v. 注意到，注意
words.example: I noticed a small mistake in your report just now.
words.exampleCn: 我刚刚注意到你报告里的一个小错误。

words.meaning: 显而易见的，值得注意的，重要的
words.example: The improvement in her painting skills is quite noticeable.
words.exampleCn: 她绘画技巧的提升相当明显。

words.example: I received a notification about the upcoming meeting this morning.
words.exampleCn: 我今天早上收到了一则关于即将召开的会议的通知。

words.example: Please notify me as soon as possible when the package arrives.
words.exampleCn: 快递到达时请尽快通知我。

words.example: I have a notion that it will rain tomorrow.
words.exampleCn: 我觉得明天会下雨。

words.meaning: 臭名昭著的,声名狼藉的
words.example: The notorious criminal was finally caught by the police.
words.exampleCn: 那个臭名昭著的罪犯最终被警方抓获了。

words.example: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, we still went on with our picnic.
words.exampleCn: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是继续进行野餐。

words.example: The final score was three nought all.
words.exampleCn: 最终比分是3比0。

words.example: The word "book" is a common noun in English.
words.exampleCn: “book”这个单词是英语中的一个常见名词。

words.example: Parents hope to nourish their children both physically and mentally.
words.exampleCn: 父母们希望在身体和精神上滋养自己的孩子。

words.example: Proper diet provides our body with necessary nourishment to stay healthy.
words.exampleCn: 合理的饮食为我们的身体提供维持健康所需的营养。

words.example: She spent three years writing her first novel about a young artist chasing dreams in Paris.
words.exampleCn: 她花了三年时间写完了自己的第一本小说，讲述了一位年轻艺术家在巴黎追逐梦想的故事。

words.example: The famous novelist will give a lecture about her new book in the city library tomorrow.
words.exampleCn: 这位知名小说家明天将在市图书馆开展一场关于她新书的讲座。

words.example: The writer published a touching novelette in the latest literary magazine.
words.exampleCn: 这位作家在最新一期文学杂志上发表了一篇动人的中篇小说。

words.example: The small boutique sells all kinds of creative novelties like hand-painted bookmarks and quirky keychains.
